justification: EXIF/GPS fallback reader for HEIC and RAW images that Pillow cannot open, for image_metadata (P259 c3). Optional: reads tags without decoding pixels; without it HEIC/RAW files are reported as not readable.
notes: Batch p2-G12-1. Pure Python, used unmodified; run only inside the core file-analysis sandbox (core/sandbox.py). pillow-heif is not used: its binary wheels bundle GPLv2 x265 (A6). ExifTool (GPL) would only ever be an external binary on PATH.
